📖 How to use

  1. Enter a duration value in the first field.
  2. Pick the unit you are converting from.
  3. Pick the unit you want to convert to.
  4. Read the result and the full conversion table for all eight units.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How long is a month and a year here?

Months use the average Gregorian month of 30.44 days and years use 365.25 days (accounting for leap years). Real calendar months vary in length.

Which time units are supported?

Milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months and years.

Why do some values show as 1.5e-7?

The table rounds to 6 decimals; very long or short durations are shown in exponential notation to stay readable.
